newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spanish government bonds closed slightly higher on Wednesday with a flattened yield curve after the Treasury auction left the market short of five-year bonds.
Long-term cash bonds and futures fell back from the day's highs when profit-taking emerged towards the close.
"We had a squeeze right after the auction," one dealer said, adding "10-year yields are at present really close to the five-year ones".
In the cash market the five-year 7.9 percent 2002 bond closed at 106.78, yielding 6.11 percent. Benchmark 8.80 percent April 2006 bonds closed at 112.35 with a yield of 6.94 percent.
"The market is betting on a sharp downtrend in the inflation rate," added another dealer. December CPI data are due next Wednesday, January 15.
